content:
This week we're back with another update on the latest additions to Apple's certified refurbished store. Highlights this week include the MacBook Neo, new MacBook Air configurations, the Apple Watch Ultra 3, and more.

Apple's certified refurbished store is a great way to purchase products through Apple's official website, with savings of up to 15%.

Here's what you need to know:

  • Quality products at attractive prices
  • Undergo a rigorous refurbishment process before being sold
  • Backed by a one-year Apple limited warranty
  • Covered by Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare products available for additional purchase
  • Engraving and gift wrapping are not available for refurbished products

We track every addition and removal from Apple's certified refurbished store, saving you the trouble of searching yourself. Inventory changes rapidly, and the purpose of this article is to keep you informed about currently available products, so you can grab your心仪 items before they sell out.

Mac computers

The MacBook Neo and MacBook Air prices remain my favourite deals. Both are ideal choices for users entering the Apple ecosystem for the first time, or upgrading to a product equipped with Apple Silicon chips.

MacBook Neo

  • MacBook Neo (256GB storage): $599 (original new price $699)
  • MacBook Neo (512GB storage with Touch ID): $679 (original new price $799)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air (512GB storage, 16GB memory): $1,099 (original new price $1,299)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air (1TB storage, 16GB memory): $1,529 (original new price $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air (2TB storage, 16GB memory): $1,949 (original new price $2,299)

iMac

  • 24-inch M4 iMac (256GB storage, 16GB memory): $1,269 (original new price $1,499)
  • 24-inch M4 iMac (512GB storage, 16GB memory): $1,439 (original new price $1,699)

Studio Display

We previously mentioned that the Studio Display XDR has appeared in Apple's refurbished store. As we often remind everyone, inventory changes can happen quickly, and the Studio Display XDR is no exception. As of today, only two configurations remain in stock:

  • Studio Display XDR (standard glass with tilt- and height-adjustable stand): $2,799 (original new price $3,299)
  • Studio Display XDR (nano-texture glass with tilt- and height-adjustable stand): $3,059 (original new price $3,599)

Apple TV 4K

The long-awaited entry-level Apple TV 4K is back in stock this week, alongside the higher-end version with an Ethernet port. The entry-level version typically sells out quickly, so if you're interested, don't hesitate.

  • Apple TV 4K (third generation, 64GB storage, Wi-Fi): $169 (original new price $199)
  • Apple TV 4K (third generation, 128GB storage, Wi-Fi + Ethernet): $209 (original new price $249)

Apple Watch Ultra

I wear the Apple Watch Ultra 3 every day. If you want to follow suit, here are this week's featured deals from Apple's refurbished store:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm black titanium case with black ocean band: $679 (original new price $799)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm natural titanium case with anchor blue ocean band: $679 (original new price $799)

As always, you can head to 9to5Toys to stay on top of all the latest Apple deals this week.
